comment: Allowlist of every data source that may appear in hypertroph+. A source with redistribution 'allowed' may be bundled/committed; 'conditional' only under its stated condition; 'forbidden' may never be bundled (runtime/user data only). Enforced by tools/compliance/check-compliance.mjs.

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central
sources.licenseName: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
sources.attribution: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. fdc.nal.usda.gov

sources.name: Free Exercise DB (yuhonas)
sources.note: Approved / public domain, but not currently bundled; seed exercises are app-authored.

sources.name: Open Food Facts
sources.condition: Any derivative database must remain under ODbL; attribute OFF. Not bundled.

sources.name: User-entered
sources.note: Runtime-only user data. Never bundled or committed.

restricted.name: ICMR-NIN Indian Food Composition Tables 2017
restricted.reason: No part may be stored/reproduced in any electronic format for creating a product without prior written permission of NIN.
restricted.handling: user-supplied only; never bundle or commit

restricted.name: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians
restricted.handling: user-supplied only; never bundle or commit

restricted.name: FSANZ AUSNUT / AFCD / NUTTAB
restricted.reason: Gated Data User Licence Agreement / CC BY-SA-ish / permission-only; no sublicensing.
restricted.handling: user-supplied only; never bundle or commit
